labels.name: Personal
labels.description: Emails written to me personally by someone I know, such as friends, family or classmates, sent directly by email. Notifications that someone messaged me on another site go to that site's label, and emails about a job application I submitted go to Applications.

labels.name: Applications
labels.description: Emails about specific job applications I submitted: application received, assessments, interviews, offers, rejections, candidate account codes and contracts to sign. Typical senders are company recruiting systems such as Workday or Greenhouse.

labels.name: Job Alerts
labels.description: Job recommendations and job alerts from job sites like LinkedIn and Indeed, for jobs I haven't applied to. Updates on a job I applied for go to Applications.

labels.name: Social Notifications
labels.description: Notifications from social networks that aren't job alerts: messages, connection requests, profile views, post reactions and career-advice newsletters.

labels.name: Events
labels.description: Events I registered for or bought tickets to: confirmations, reminders and changes. Invitations to events I didn't sign up for go to Promotions.

labels.name: Orders & Payments
labels.description: Order confirmations, shipping and delivery updates, receipts, invoices, payment notices and subscription charges. Pure sales offers go to Promotions.

labels.name: Security & Logins
labels.description: Sign-in links, one-time login or verification codes, password resets and security alerts. Codes requested as part of a job application go to Applications.

labels.name: Promotions
labels.description: Marketing newsletters, offers, vouchers and webinar invitations from brands and services.
